item.command:
/bin/zsh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('/Users/leo/workspace/code-is-cheap/docs/gateflow/codex-server-retry-recovery/evidence/live-probes-20261013-105713/gpt-6-sol/input.json')
target = Path('/Users/leo/workspace/code-is-cheap/docs/gateflow/codex-server-retry-recovery/evidence/live-probes-20261013-105713/gpt-6-sol/result.json')
with source.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    data = json.load(stream)
values = data['values']
result = {'probe': data['probe'], 'count': len(values), 'sum': sum(values)}
with target.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    json.dump(result, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    stream.write('\\n')
print(json.dumps({'created': str(target), 'result': result}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
